title: 第13章 升命大丰收第14章 练拳真难

从郑瀚身上讨回了自己该得的，敖鹏也顺势放下了郑瀚。
但即使是这样，两个人仍然被叫到了教导处。
好在敖鹏只是提了一下郑瀚的衣领，连一拳都没有打，系主任知道了前因后果，也只是口头警告了一下。
末了，他让郑瀚先出去，敖鹏留下，语重心长地说道，“你还年轻，千万不要为了这件事毁了前途，你的情况我已经知道了，好生用功，争取考个好成绩，期末的时候我看能不能帮你申请一个特困生的名额。”
系主任能够帮到这里，已经是他最大的权限了，敖鹏也不是那种不知好歹的人，“主任放心，我刚刚就是气不过，现在气消了，也想通了。”
听到敖鹏听劝，系主任自然也没有多想，轻轻点头，“行，中午了，那你去吃饭吧。”
敖鹏走出系院办公室。
他和郑瀚这次因果确实了结了，但是已经有神通种子在身，敖鹏近乎神而明之地预感到郑瀚不想要了结这段因果。
这次郑瀚在所有人面前丢了面子，但敖鹏却没有拿他怎么样，他自然想要报复回来。
敖鹏嘴角泛起冷意，他还就怕郑瀚不报复呢！
郑瀚不想要了结这段因果，他自然有本事继续收利息！
随后敖鹏看向自己收取的利息，一两一钱！
敖鹏简直脸都要笑开花了，根本压不住嘴角的笑意。
去他妈的黄大仙，一群穷鬼，几百只都抵不上一个人！
怪不得黄大仙不互相讨封，这骗一个活人的利润实在是太大了！
唯一可惜的是，因为有真君的提醒，讨封这个技能敖鹏不敢随意乱用。
想想也是，这么牛逼的技能，如果没有点禁忌，随意就可以使用，那么天下谁还修道修佛，都学讨封技能，互相骗就是了！
讨封确实有各种禁忌，最大的缺点就是根本学不会！
普通人，甚至神佛都学不会。

讨封，讨还在封之前。
何为讨，那是要饭，需要命格低贱至极！
这本身就是天留一线生机，给那些命格低贱之物翻身的机缘。
人就算命格再低贱，也有二两一钱命！
原本是不可能学会这个技能的。
但没想到敖鹏这个还魂尸，一开始还没有完全掌握身体的时候，命格基本上等于零，介于生死叠加的状态，在有命格的事物里，没有什么东西比他命格还低了，而他又遇到了一只讨封的黄皮子……
讨封只能够由命格低向命格高讨要，不能命格高向命格低讨要。
敖鹏之所以能够从黄皮子身上获得一些命钱，最主要还是黄皮子被自己的讨封术反噬。
由此可见每一两命钱有多珍贵!
说一句逆天改命毫不过分。
这一两一钱命，加上之前剩下的八分七厘。
敖鹏也没有心思去吃饭，直接开始加点。
【你提升了一钱命，你的命格变为二两三钱，你的天赋‘牌位’激活，获得传承技能垂钓。】
看来这个二两三钱命的祖先命也不好，技能居然是钓鱼佬。
敖鹏继续给自己命格加点！
【你提升了一钱命，你的命格变为二两四钱，你的天赋‘牌位’激活，获得传承技能长走。】
这应该是个拉黄包车的命。
【你提升了一钱命，你的命格变为二两五钱，你的天赋‘牌位’激活，获得传承技能缝纫。】
这个命逐渐好了起来，起码有份在家里面的工作。
【你提升了一钱命，你的命格变为二两六钱，你的天赋‘牌位’激活，获得传承技能珠心算。】

【你提升了一钱命，你的命格变为二两七钱，你的天赋‘牌位’激活，获得传承技能六合大刀。】

After getting what he deserved from Zheng Han, Ao Peng also let go of Zheng Han.
But even so, the two people were still called to the teaching office.
Fortunately, Ao Peng only lifted Zheng Han's collar and didn't even punch him. The department head knew the cause and effect and only gave him a verbal warning.
At the end, he asked Zheng Han to go out first, while Ao Peng stayed behind and said sincerely, "You are still young. Don't ruin your future because of this matter. I already know your situation. Study hard and try to get good grades. At the end of the semester, I will see if I can help you apply for a place for extremely poor students."
The dean of the department can help here, which is already within his maximum authority. Ao Peng is not the kind of person who is ungrateful. "Don't worry, director, I was just angry just now. Now that I'm gone, I've figured it out."
Hearing that Ao Peng listened to the advice, the department head naturally didn't think much and nodded gently, "Okay, it's noon, then you can go have dinner."
Ao Peng walked out of the department office.
He and Zheng Han had indeed settled their cause and effect this time, but with the magical seeds already in their bodies, Ao Peng had an almost divine premonition that Zheng Han did not want to end the cause and effect.
This time Zheng Han lost face in front of everyone, but Ao Peng didn't do anything to him. Naturally, he wanted to take revenge.
There was a coldness in the corner of Ao Peng's mouth. He was afraid that Zheng Han would not retaliate!
Zheng Han didn't want to end this relationship, so he naturally had the ability to continue collecting interest!
Then Ao Peng looked at the interest he had collected, one tael per cent!
Ao Peng's face almost burst into laughter, and he couldn't suppress the smile at the corner of his mouth.
Damn Wong Tai Sin, a bunch of poor people, hundreds of them are not worth one person!
No wonder Wong Tai Sin doesn't ask for each other's titles. The profit from defrauding a living person is really too great!
The only pity is that, because of Zhenjun's reminder, Ao Peng did not dare to use the skill of seeking a seal at will.
Think about it, if such an awesome skill has no taboos and can be used casually, then everyone in the world who practices Taoism and Buddhism will just learn to gain skills and cheat each other!
There are indeed various taboos in asking for a title, and the biggest drawback is that you can’t learn them at all!
Ordinary people, not even gods and Buddhas, can learn it.
Asking for a seal is still before sealing.
What is begging? It is begging for food, which requires an extremely low life!
This in itself is a glimmer of hope left in the sky, a chance for those with low destiny to turn around.
No matter how humble a person's fate is, he still has a life of two taels and one penny!
It would have been impossible to learn this skill originally.
But he didn't expect that Ao Peng, a resurrected corpse, had basically zero life when he didn't fully control his body at the beginning. He was in a state of superposition of life and death. Among things with a life, there was nothing lower than his life. And he met another yellow-skinned man who wanted to be sealed...
To ask for a title, you can only ask for it from a person with a low destiny to a person with a high destiny, but not from a person with a high destiny to a person with a low destiny.
The main reason why Ao Peng was able to get some life money from Huang Pizi was that Huang Pizi was counterattacked by his own seal-seeking technique.
This shows how valuable every life or two of money is!
It is not an exaggeration to say that one can change one's destiny against the will of heaven.
This two-yuan life, plus the remaining eighty-seven cents.
Ao Peng had no intention of eating and started to add more food.
[You have gained one life, your life has changed to two, two, three, your talent ‘tablet’ is activated, and you have acquired the inherited skill of fishing. 】
It seems that this ancestor with a life of 2, 2, 3 and 3 gold is also not good in life, and his skill is actually that of a fisherman.
Ao Peng continues to add points to his life!
[You have gained one life, your life has changed to two, two, and four. Your talent ‘tablet’ is activated, and you can acquire inherited skills. 】
This should be the fate of pulling a rickshaw.
[You have increased your life by one dollar, and your life has changed to two, two, and five dollars. Your talent 'tablet' is activated and you have acquired the inherited skill of sewing. 】
My life is getting better gradually, and at least I have a job at home.
[You have improved your life by one coin, your destiny has become twenty-two-six coins, your talent hasThe ‘tablet’ is activated and the inherited skill abacus mental arithmetic is obtained. 】
[You have increased your life by one dollar, your life has changed to twenty-two-seven dollars, your talent ‘tablet’ is activated, and you have acquired the inherited skill Liuhe Broadsword. 】
